column1: # Game profile of Battle Brothers (Switch, update 1.14.0 = v917504)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Overhype Studios' own engine (Squirrel 3.0.4 scripts, NoesisGUI interface), SDK 13.3.2, NVN; modules main and sdk only.
# The shaders are 17 GLSLC outputs in data/shaders/*.nvn and 27 embedded in main (shader_split.py).
# Status: plays on Android (README.md). Generated by dm/games/profile_guess.py from the survey; the memory keys are its guess,
# and the game sets a 2.68 GB heap in them on the device
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 476 MB of bss (counted as used memory): a 2816 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
